# Vendored dependency

`polygon-clipping-0.15.7.umd.min.js` is polygon-clipping 0.15.7, MIT licensed.

- Source: https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/polygon-clipping@0.15.7/dist/polygon-clipping.umd.min.js
- License: `polygon-clipping-LICENSE.md`

Used locally for exact planar union, hole handling and rectangle containment of projected parcel boundaries. No browser request to a third-party geometry service is made.
